FEBS Event

31 May – 4 June 2028

 Sant Feliu de Guixols, Spain

Transcription mechanisms across evolution

Event website

The FEBS Workshop ‘Transcription mechanisms across evolution’ will take place 31 May – 4 June 2028 in Sant Feliu de Guixols, Spain, at the Hotel Eden Roc. This meeting builds on the successful FEBS 2025 Workshop ‘Conservation and diversity of gene regulatory mechanisms across eukaryotes’.

This workshop will encompass transcription as a key biological mechanism shaped by evolutionary selection. It is designed to break down disciplinary and phylogenetic barriers by bringing together researchers studying transcription and genome regulation across the tree of life. By presenting transcriptional mechanisms from bacteriophages, bacteria, archaea, and diverse model and non-model eukaryotic systems and approaches side-by-side, the workshop aims to provide a unique opportunity to discuss unifying principles and evolutionary innovations, and to facilitate new ways of thinking about how transcriptional mechanisms have been shaped and reshaped through evolution. Key themes include the evolution of transcriptional machinery, regulation of transcription initiation, elongation, and termination, transcription in chromatin context, dynamic control of gene expression, stress responses, genome instability, and transcription in pathogenesis and disease. The workshop will incorporate recent advances in imaging, single-molecule and single-cell approaches, structural biology, genomics, and computational and machine-learning methods.

The meeting will also include an optional tutorial session to introduce participants to computational and comparative approaches for studying genome evolution, transcriptional regulation, and the evolutionary conservation and diversification of gene regulatory mechanisms, thereby complementing the scientific themes of the workshop and strengthening its training component.

A central objective is to foster cross-disciplinary dialogue, engage early career scientist, and promote discussion. The programme is carefully balanced with invited speakers, selected presentations from abstracts, flash-talks, poster sessions and networking opportunities to facilitate interactions among researchers at all career levels.

We invite you to read a FEBS Network post from a participant in the 2025 workshop.

Organizers: Julie Soutourina, Mo Motamedi, Folkert van Werven, Kristina Zumer
